text:
marie: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR that updates the KMS integration section and replaces an inline key example with a redacted snippet. Need cross-team signoff before merge because it touches ‘sensitive’ examples. CI/docs preview is failing right now. Can security/legal weigh in?

jordan: @marie thanks — can you paste the exact lines you removed/changed? legal needs to confirm redaction is sufficient for compliance. timeline? :eyes:

marie: yes — PR 5123. Removed the raw key example and added this placeholder:

```
# Do not store plaintext keys here — use KMS to wrap secrets
kms_key: <REDACTED: KMS_KEY_ID>
```

I also linked a migration guide and added an SDK snippet that uses our KMS client. Hoping to merge during tomorrow's docs-staging window (09:00-10:00 PT).

sam: pinging from security — quick checklist: (1) confirm no real key fingerprints left, (2) ensure snippet uses client abstraction (not raw credentials), (3) add note about audit logging. If you can post the failing CI error that'd help. :lock:

marie: CI failure is the docs preview check complaining about broken anchor: `#kms-client-usage` not found in the page after I moved the section. Link is fixed in the branch, but preview still failing on the preview job. Logs: 

```
Error: broken link - /docs/integrations#kms-client-usage (404)
Exited with code 1
```

alex: I can re-run the preview job once legal okays redaction. Quick note: the SDK snippet uses `KMSClient.wrap_key()` which is the recommended API; no raw creds.

jordan: I reviewed the redaction in the diff. The placeholder looks fine, but legal needs an explicit statement on retention policy for example payloads. Can you add one line: "Example values must not be retained in CI artifacts or screenshots."

marie: added that sentence and pushed. Also removed a screenshot that had a test key in it.

sam: re-reviewing — screenshot removal + placeholder + audit note :thumbsup:. Security approves conditioned on CI artifacts not containing the redacted token. We should ensure the docs preview job masks artifacts or deletes them after publish. @deploy-bot can you confirm preview artifacts retention?

deploy-bot: docs-preview-job #5123 finished with status: failed -> re-run required. Artifacts retained for 7 days. Masked variables used in build logs: REDWOOD_KMS_TOKEN (masked).

alex: I can trigger a rebuild with artifact cleanup step after build. Will add `rm -rf /tmp/docs-artifacts/*` to the job then re-run.

marie: Great. Plan: (1) legal add retention sentence — done. (2) security approve — done. (3) alex will add artifact cleanup and re-run preview. (4) merge in docs-staging window tomorrow 09:00 PT if preview passes. Everyone ok?

jordan: OK from legal after the retention sentence is present. Please keep this in the PR description for audit.

sam: OK from security. Add a short note in the security-review checklist in the PR.

alex: Pushed cleanup change and restarted preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-5123 — waiting on successful job.

deploy-bot: docs-preview-job #5123 re-run finished: success. Link: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-5123 (expires in 7 days)

marie: Awesome. I'll schedule merge for 09:05 PT tomorrow to give a 5m buffer for final checks. If anything else pops up ping @marie. Thanks all! :rocket:
